description: Ranged Fire DPS built on periodic damage. Ignite and Blaze roll, Flare Bolt and Lava Shard fill, and the pile of burning effects gets dumped into Explode, Pillar of Flame and Pyroclasm.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_pyromancer__incineration.txt and the incineration block of reference/coa_sidekick/talents/pyromancer.json. CoA calls this 'Closest to retail Fire Mage. The core loop is mechanically Fire Mage's Ignite/Combustion snowball.' Its stat priority is Spell Hit > Intellect > Critical Strike > Haste > Spell Power > Spirit/MP5, which is why the tree spends on crit, crit damage and periodic damage and never on Spirit. CoA's 40-node Incineration tree plus its 26-point class tree is selected down to 23 nodes here; the class-tree picks that survived are the ones the reference's own 26/26 build takes (Fire Safety).

nodes.name: Magnitude 10
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Flare Bolt by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Magnitude 10 - Increases the critical strike chance of Flare Bolt by 5%' (2 ranks). Spread over 5 Frontier ranks for the same total.

nodes.name: Cataclysmic Power
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Flare Bolt by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Flare Bolt by 3% for each periodic effect you have on the target' (3 ranks). Nothing counts a target's live DoTs for a damage multiplier, so this is a flat Flare Bolt bonus - the effect at a full DoT spread, without the condition.

nodes.name: Embrace the Fire
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Blaze and Ignite by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Blaze and Ignite by 20%'.

nodes.name: Fire Safety
nodes.description: Increases your Fire damage by 2% per rank and reduces the threat you generate by 4%.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'Increases your Fire damage and healing by 2% and reduces your threat generated by -10%' (2 ranks). Frontier has no shared class tree, so the class-tree picks a spec actually takes are folded into its spec tree - the Incineration build page takes 26/26 class points, so these are not optional in CoA either. Note the key: threat_generation_pct as a TALENT effect is a fraction, and only started working at all in 992ed62.

nodes.name: Searing Power
nodes.description: Increases your Fire spell power by 8 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the spell power scaling of Flare Bolt by 20%'. Per-ability spell-power scaling is not a thing the engine exposes; school spell power is, and it is read at runtime as f'{school}_spell_power'.

nodes.name: Explosive
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your periodic effects by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the tick rate of Blaze and Ignite by -10%' (2 ranks). Tick rate is a real-time concept; one DoT tick per turn is fixed here, so a faster tick becomes a bigger one.

nodes.name: Pyromaniac
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Ember spenders by 5%'. No Ember category exists to restrict it to, so it is general spell crit - which the spec's own stat priority leads with after hit and Intellect.

nodes.name: Stoke
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your periodic effects by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Ignite and Infernus now extend their own duration on the target by 3 sec, up to a maximum of 12 sec.' A crit-driven extension has no hook; a flat duration increase is the same trade.

nodes.name: Wreath of Flames
nodes.description: Your spells have a 15% chance per rank to grant Flamecasting, increasing your haste for a few turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic Fire damage now has a 10% chance to grant a stack of Flamecasting, or 2 stacks if they critically strike.' See flamecasting() for why there is no stack ramp.

nodes.name: Melting Point
nodes.description: Increases the critical damage of your spells by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Fire spells now increase the chance for the enemy to be critically hit with spells by 3% for 12 seconds.' A debuff that raises crit chance AGAINST a target has no key - spell_damage_taken_pct is read off the character TAKING damage, not the one dealing it, so using it here would have made this talent hurt the player. Crit damage on your own side is the honest version.

nodes.name: Molten Storm
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Lava Shard by 5% and its critical strike chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance and damage of Lava Shard by 10%.'

nodes.name: Fiery Passion
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%... In addition, your spell haste is increased by 3%.' A passive party aura from a talent has no hook - talent effects apply to their owner only - so only the personal half survives. The reference is blunt that this is the spec's whole support contribution: 'a raid haste aura... bolted on'.

nodes.name: Lighting the Fuse
nodes.description: Grants spell critical strike chance equal to 2% of your Intellect per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Allows your periodic effects to critically strike and increases your spell critical strike chance by 15% of your Intellect.' A real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion, resolved against character.py's shared STAT_CONVERSION maps. DoT crit is already on by default here, so only the conversion is authored.

nodes.name: To Ashes
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to restore 60 mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damaging critical strikes now generate 10 Heat and restore 3% of your base mana.' The Heat half has no pool; the mana half is a real grant_resource proc.

nodes.name: Combustion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Explode by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Explode is now increased by 15% for each of your Pyromancer periodic effects on the target.' Same missing DoT-count hook as Cataclysmic Power, same flat treatment.

nodes.name: Rapid Incineration
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Lava Shard by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Consuming Embers now reduces the cooldown of Lava Shard and Pillar of Flame by 10%.' Note the sign: ability_<id>_cooldown_pct is applied as cd * (1 - pct), so POSITIVE is the reduction. Eight talents across four classes once authored this negative and quietly made their own spells worse.

nodes.name: Pillar of Flame
nodes.description: Learn Pillar of Flame, opening the ground under an enemy and splashing the ones beside them.
nodes._source: CoA: a 1 TE spec talent behind an 8 TE gate, so it is a talent-granted ability here rather than a level unlock - same requires_talent/unlock_ability shape mage_pyroblast uses.

nodes.name: Destroyer's Legacy
nodes.description: Increases the damage your abilities deal to additional targets by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Lava Shard on enemies affected by Blaze now blasts nearby enemies for 20% of the damage dealt as Fire damage' - the spec's cleave, which the reference says 'costs you almost nothing' once the DoTs are rolling.

nodes.name: Dark Iron Legacy
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Meteor by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Targets affected by the disorient from Meteor take an additional 40% increased damage from the next Explode or Lava Shard.' A conditional follow-up window has no hook, so the bonus lands on Meteor itself.

nodes.name: Fired Up!
nodes.description: Learn Fired Up!, which makes your next spell instant.
nodes._source: CoA: a 1 TE tier-0 spec talent. The CoA version makes every Ember spender instant for 15 seconds; enable_instant_cast is a single next-cast window, which is as close as the engine gets.

nodes.name: Flamespiller
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Explode by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Explode or Flames of Neltharion now extend the duration of Fired Up by 0.5 sec.' Extending a buff off a crit has no hook; making those crits happen is the same loop.

nodes.name: Arsonist
nodes.description: Increases the critical damage of your Fire spells by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical damage of your Ember spenders by 10%'. fire_crit_damage_pct is one of the school keys the engine assembles at runtime, so a literal grep calls it dead - it is not.

nodes.name: Pyroclasm
nodes.description: Learn Pyroclasm, which tears every fire you have lit out of one enemy at once. Also increases the damage of your periodic effects by 10%.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA's own Incineration tier-6 pick and the payoff the whole tree builds toward: 'Once it is rolling a target or a clump melts.' The DoT bonus is here because Pyroclasm's real damage IS the DoTs it consumes, which the engine cannot read - scaling them is the closest honest version of 'two times total periodic damage'.
